important_factors: Usable inventory of 380 units leaves 600 units of baseline unmet demand over the 28-day horizon
First stockout projected for 2026-09-27 without purchase
Ordering 800 units from SUP-A arrives on 2026-09-24, fully resolving unmet demand
Closing inventory ends at 200 units, matching safety stock target
Total cost of $9,600.00 is feasible within $20,000.00 available budget
args.rationale: The baseline projection indicates usable stock of 380 units against a 28-day demand forecast of 980 units (35 units/day), resulting in 600 total unmet units and a first stockout date on 2026-09-27. Ordering 800 units from supplier SUP-A at $12.00 per unit ($9,600.00 total) with a 7-day lead time results in expected receipt on 2026-09-24, prior to the stockout date. This action eliminates all 600 units of unmet demand, maintains peak storage occupancy at 38.7 m³ (well within the 200.0 m³ limit), and leaves closing inventory at 200 units (matching safety stock policy). While the total spend of $9,600.00 exceeds the $2,000.00 autonomy spend limit and requires buyer approval, it is fully feasible within the available budget of $20,000.00.
